sections.title: Zero bank connections. Ever.
text: While other expense trackers want your banking credentials, Spend Easy takes a different approach. You type what you spent—in a few words—so you stay in control and your bank login stays yours.

items.title: Add it in a sentence
items.text: Type “Lunch 14.50” or “Groceries 82 yesterday”. Spend Easy reads the amount, the category and the day, and you confirm with a tap.

items.title: What’s left, up front
items.text: This month leads with what’s left in your budget and what that means for each day left, and tells you when you’re close to the limit.

items.title: Budgets and alerts
items.text: Daily, weekly or monthly budgets, with optional alerts when you reach the level you pick and again if you go over.

items.title: Your categories
items.text: Your own names, icons and colors, in your order. Tap one to see this month against last and six months of history.

items.title: Trends
items.text: A week, a month or a year at a time, compared with the one before, with every category’s share.

items.title: Repeating expenses
items.text: Rent, phone and subscriptions are added again on each date they repeat. Export everything as CSV whenever you like.

sections.label: YOUR DATA. YOUR DEVICE.
sections.title: Privacy isn't a feature. It's the foundation.
text: No analytics. No tracking. No ads. Spend Easy will never ask for your bank login. Your expenses, budgets and categories live on your device—in the app and its widget—and nowhere else.

cta.title: Start tracking.
cta.text: Free on the App Store for iPhone and iPad. No account required.
